program: Wingless RSI corrective tranche: calibration feature representation attribution
question: Are residual cross-manifest calibration errors caused by R27 omitting domain identity, adaptation-budget position, or their combination from the six-feature representation?
hypothesis: R31-R33 ruled out sign-count polarity, magnitude conflict/extrapolation, and jackknife instability as useful residual-error discriminators. R27 currently pools code, structured, and technical-prose intervals and all adaptation stages into one six-feature ridge mapping. Freeze a 2x2 representation factorial before held-out outcomes: BASE6 uses the unchanged six R27 rates; DOMAIN augments BASE6 with two fixed domain indicators (code and structured, technical-prose reference); BUDGET augments BASE6 with normalized upper-budget position hi/max_budget_for_domain; DOMAIN_BUDGET includes both. For each outer holdout, fit every representation on the other three manifests with ridge lambda=1 and deterministic elimination, predict the exact R30-excluded candidate set, then open held-out outcomes. This is diagnostic attribution only and cannot change allocator behavior.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: jackknife sign instability or high relative jackknife spread identifies residual calibration error inside the exact R30-excluded set
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: the remaining calibration error may be representational: domain and adaptation-stage information are absent from the pooled R27 six-feature vector

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R33's sign-instability cases were substantially less error-prone than controls, while high-spread cases had larger MAE but lower sign-error rate; neither preregistered diagnostic enriched both error dimensions.
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: representation attribution only; same four sealed manifests, exact R30 exclusion rule, ten candidate allocations, 1744-byte budget, ridge lambda, outcome labels, held-out ordering, substrate capacity and evaluator

representation_factorial.BASE6: unchanged R27 six per-byte structural rates
representation_factorial.DOMAIN: BASE6 plus two fixed one-hot domain indicators: code and structured; technical-prose is reference
representation_factorial.BUDGET: BASE6 plus normalized upper-budget position hi/max_budget_for_domain
representation_factorial.DOMAIN_BUDGET: BASE6 plus both fixed domain indicators and normalized budget position

cause_effect_trace.fit_rule: each representation is fitted independently on the same three training manifests for each outer holdout; ridge lambda=1 on non-intercept coefficients; deterministic Gaussian elimination; no representation selected from outcomes
cause_effect_trace.attribution_rule: compare held-out sign-error rate and MAE of each preregistered representation on the exact 33 R30-excluded cases; factor effects require paired improvement across the factorial, not a single post-hoc best arm
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: R34 cannot alter allocator behavior. Supported representation evidence only authorizes a separately preregistered correction/replication.

frozen_reuse.budget_position: upper interval budget divided by that domain's maximum preregistered adaptation budget

effect_rules.domain_main_effect: DOMAIN improves sign-error by >=0.10 and MAE ratio <=0.90 versus BASE6, AND DOMAIN_BUDGET improves sign-error by >=0.10 and MAE ratio <=0.90 versus BUDGET
effect_rules.budget_main_effect: BUDGET improves sign-error by >=0.10 and MAE ratio <=0.90 versus BASE6, AND DOMAIN_BUDGET improves sign-error by >=0.10 and MAE ratio <=0.90 versus DOMAIN
effect_rules.interaction_effect: DOMAIN_BUDGET improves sign-error by >=0.15 and MAE ratio <=0.80 versus BASE6 while neither domain_main_effect nor budget_main_effect holds

classification_rules.supported: valid AND at least one of domain_main_effect, budget_main_effect, interaction_effect is true
classification_rules.mixed: valid AND at least one augmented representation improves both sign-error and MAE versus BASE6 but no preregistered factor effect meets its full threshold
classification_rules.negative: valid AND no augmented representation improves both sign-error and MAE versus BASE6
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, 1744 budget, candidate set, exact R30 exclusion reproduction, BASE6 identity, domain encoding, budget-position formula, ridge lambda/solver, representation freezing, held-out ordering, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance or accounting requirement fails

thresholds.provenance: fixed before R34 execution; no threshold selected from R33 outcomes beyond choosing the preregistered feature-representation successor family

rsi_success_note: R34 is attribution on already studied manifests and cannot establish prospective allocator success.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, exact R30 exclusion rule, candidate allocations, BASE6 features, domain encoding, budget-position formula, ridge lambda/solver, factorial cells, thresholds, budgets/capacity, held-out ordering, classification, or authority after primary output.
